fatal_issues: The source-unit schema does not enforce the protocol's requirement that backend-visible fields are exactly ['unit_id','search_text'] for all backends; it only constrains the field value, not that the backend receives only those fields.

The query-log schema allows 'authored_diagnostic_development_only' queries to be recorded with 'collection_phase'='prospective_test', violating the protocol's exclusion of authored diagnostics from the confirmatory set.
The protocol's sample-size rule requires at least 30 queries per H1 stratum, but the schema and manifest do not enforce or record stratum membership per query, making the requirement unverifiable.
The query-log schema does not enforce that 'recorded_at' precedes the query cutoff commit's commit time; it only stores a timestamp and commit, with no linkage to commit-time validation.

The source-unit schema allows 'valid_time' and 'recorded_time' to be null, but the protocol requires that only durable records whose valid-time and commit/event time precede the query timestamp may be gold evidence; null times would violate this.
The protocol requires that exact duplicate aliases preserve every source alias, but the schema's 'source_aliases' array is optional and not required, so a unit could omit aliases.
The schema does not enforce that 'search_text_sha256' equals the SHA-256 of 'search_text'; it only checks format.
The schema does not enforce that 'source_blob_sha256' equals the SHA-256 of the exact historical file bytes; it only checks format.
The schema does not enforce that 'unit_id' is derived from the canonical tuple as described; it only checks pattern.
The query-log schema does not enforce that 'origin_receipt' mode 'private_keyed_digest' has a key outside Git; it only stores a value.

The protocol requires that private query text and origin mappings remain in local-restricted storage, but the schema allows 'storage_class'='git_public' for private origin types, potentially leaking private query text.
The schema does not enforce that 'pre_output_attestation' is exactly the required string; it uses 'const' but the string is not the exact protocol wording.
The protocol requires that the builder never reads the working tree, but the schema does not include a field to attest to the reconstruction method; only the protocol prose states it.
The schema does not enforce that 'git_object_format' matches the actual repository's object format; it only checks consistency between fields.

The protocol requires that symlinks, gitlinks, binary blobs, non-UTF-8 text, malformed rows, and duplicate JSON members fail closed, but the schema does not include an exclusion reason field for such units; they are simply absent.
The protocol requires that CSV and JSONL canonicalization preserves original column order and header, but the schema does not include a field to record the original header or column order for audit.
The protocol requires that oversized units split only at paragraph boundaries, but the schema does not include a field to indicate that a unit is a split part or to link to the original source range.
The protocol requires that the query cutoff commit is the exact tree at query time, but the schema does not enforce that the commit is an ancestor of the current HEAD or that it is a valid commit.
The protocol requires that development and test queries never share a query episode, but the schema does not include a field to link queries to episodes or to prevent reuse.

The protocol requires that test queries that trigger protocol repair are preserved as invalidated and cannot re-enter later tests, but the schema only has an optional 'exclusion_reason' with no enforcement of permanent invalidation.

The protocol requires that the primary analysis excludes CURRENT_STATE.md and secondary includes it, but the eligibility policy only marks it as registered_factor_only; the schema does not enforce that it is excluded from primary backend inputs.
The protocol requires that all backends receive byte-identical units, but the schema does not include a field to attest to byte-identical delivery; only the manifest claims it.
The protocol requires that the dense model is frozen and manifest-locked, but the experiment manifest does not include a model manifest or a field to record the frozen model revision.
The protocol requires that the sample size is frozen before prospective backend labels are analyzed, but the manifest only has a status field with no enforcement of the freeze order.
The protocol requires that system identities are revealed only after blinded primary analysis freezes, but the manifest does not include a field to record the blinding status or reveal timestamp.
The protocol requires that the primary endpoint is binary all_required_evidence_in_top5, but the schema does not include a field to record the required evidence set per query.
The protocol requires that stale and poison intrusion are measured, but the schema does not include fields to label units as stale or poison.
The protocol requires that acceptable-alternative coverage is measured, but the schema does not include fields to label acceptable alternatives.
The protocol requires that the reader-pack comparison uses a frozen byte budget, but the manifest does not include that budget.
The protocol requires that the development set is outcome-hidden, but the schema does not include a field to attest to that.
The protocol requires that the builder produces a manifest twice with byte-identical hashes, but the schema does not include a field to record the manifest hash or build process.
The protocol requires that the query log is immutable, but the schema does not include a field to record an immutable timestamp or hash chain.
The protocol requires that the query author remains blind to all backend output until the query record is immutable, but the schema does not include a field to attest to that.
The protocol requires that the gold evidence includes only records written before query time, but the schema does not enforce that the source unit's commit time precedes the query timestamp.
The protocol requires that the builder never follows symlinks or submodules, but the schema does not include a field to record that such entries were excluded with a counted reason.
The protocol requires that the source-unit manifest is frozen before test, but the manifest does not include a field to record the manifest hash or freeze timestamp.
The protocol requires that the dense model is selected on development only, but the manifest does not include a field to record the development selection process.
The protocol requires that the RRF depth is frozen before test, but the manifest does not include a field to record the frozen depth.
The protocol requires that the tie-break uses opaque unit ID ascending, but the schema does not enforce that unit IDs are opaque and not derived from path or time.

The protocol requires that the primary backends receive no path, filename, time, status, trust, or label, but the schema includes fields like 'path', 'valid_time', 'status', 'trust' that are not marked as backend-hidden; only 'backend_visible_fields' is constrained.
The protocol requires that the query log records a UTC timestamp, but the schema does not enforce that 'recorded_at' is in UTC.
The protocol requires that the query log records the origin type, but the schema allows 'authored_diagnostic_development_only' which is not a valid origin type for test queries.
The protocol requires that the query log records the language, but the schema allows 'other' which may not be a valid language for the H1 strata.
The protocol requires that the query log records the storage class, but the schema does not enforce that private queries have storage_class='local_restricted'.
The protocol requires that the query log records the pre-output attestation, but the schema uses a const string that is not the exact protocol wording.

The protocol requires that the query log records the collection phase, but the schema does not enforce that prospective_test queries have origin_type not equal to 'authored_diagnostic_development_only'.
The protocol requires that the query log records the recorded_by_role, but the schema allows 'automated_capture' which may not be a valid role for authentic queries.
